title: Disaster Detected
description: AI-powered sensors detect seismic activity, flood levels, or fire signatures. Satellite imagery confirms threat assessment.

title: SOS Generated
description: Emergency broadcast sent to all registered devices. Evacuation zones calculated and published in real time.

title: Team Assigned
description: Nearest rescue teams automatically dispatched. Volunteer network activated with skill-matched assignments.

title: Citizens Rescued
description: Search and rescue operations complete. Family reunification services activated. Recovery phase initiated.
